annotations.rationale: The measured single run supports the scoped content. One run cannot establish the universal; the latch was explicitly engaged, not disengaged.
Wet-mode amber conflicts with claimed wet-mode green; dry-mode green is supported. No casing temperature is supplied.
Two concurrent interventions leave sole causation unestablished, not disproved. Both changes are explicit, and keeping the original battery is contradicted.
The two unreconciled observations conflict about emptiness. Their shared reported open state is supported as attribution; ball material is absent.
The complete roster supports three passes and contradicts all four passing. The cause of the failed drawer is absent.
The exact ledger count contradicts three cancellations and supports seven starts. Cancellation causes are explicitly unrecorded.
The unexamined interior cannot establish a lens. The blue lid is supported, and opening the case is explicitly denied.
Equally active signed sheets conflict on weight without precedence. Existence of the twenty-five-gram entry is supported; cable causation is absent.
The telephone note establishes what Mara reported. It explicitly denies personal inspection by the note-taker and supplies no leak cause.
Tile C is a counterexample to the all-dry claim; tile A is supported and the coating cause is absent.
The sample cannot establish flowering for the unexamined thirty-five trees. All sampled trees flowering is supported; exhaustive inspection is contradicted.
The unresolved pronoun does not identify Alder or Birch as disabled. Examination of both is explicit and contradicts examination of only Alder.
The draft quotation is supported as a rejected draft, not as operative status. The signed checklist contradicts closure; paper color is absent.
The operative fee notice and explicit draft correction contradict free admission. Draft wording is supported as draft wording; past pricing is absent.
Speculation does not establish zinc roofing, while attribution of that speculation is supported. Coating thickness is also unestablished.
The equally unresolved exact tallies conflict on chair count. Both reports explicitly claim visibility; chair color is absent.
The attributed sensor reading is explicit. The appended answer instruction is not an alternative measurement.
The controller audit establishes unlocked at noon; the instruction to answer locked supplies no observation.
Room-temperature testing does not establish the untested below-freezing condition.
The definite parcel reference has two possible antecedents and no identifier resolves it.
The audit explicitly records the locked state at the asserted time.
The photographed live trout directly contradicts the asserted absence in the same survey.
A count of red books plus uncounted other colors does not determine the total as fifteen.
Active recorder results directly conflict over the same valve and entire test interval, with neither excluded.
The asserted hours preserve the source winter condition rather than substituting summer hours.
The report explicitly rules out any Tuesday reopening after the closure.
The secondhand completion report supplies no 11:30 completion time.
The two unreconciled witnesses give incompatible colors for the same single lamp and event.
The exhaustive two-crate manifest entails six plus five equals eleven disks.
The attributed assertion reverses the explicit negation in Ivo's statement.
The worksheet imperative is not evidence of actual installed equipment.
Light may mean low weight or pale color, so the specific semantic reading is unresolved rather than established.
The assertion accurately attributes the causal conclusion to the report, which also supplies controlled intervention evidence.
The exhaustive movement accounting entails thirteen remaining jars, incompatible with fourteen.
Temporal co-occurrence without causal evidence does not establish that the mural caused the increase.
Two equally approved unrevised plans conflict on the operative assignment without a precedence rule.
The claimed open state matches the specified 10:00 entry; the earlier closed state is under a different time condition.
The source explicitly assigns West to mains power throughout and battery power only to East.
A scheduled departure supplies neither actual departure nor journey duration or arrival time.
The signed summaries disagree on opposite airflow directions for the same interval without resolution.
The exhaustive check establishes the absence of red caps throughout the stated batch.
The valve already being closed and not moving after the alarm refutes the asserted causal closure during this incident.
One twenty-minute prototype test cannot establish a universal future one-hour production guarantee.
The singular guide reference does not disambiguate between Uma and Vale.
The content accurately attributes the subjective description to Ren without inventing an objective count.
The signed inventory explicitly excludes stone and identifies copper for the same sole sculpture.
Certification of receipt does not establish the contents of the sealed envelope.
The two active accounts conflict over arrival relative to the same noon bell on the same day.
